name: Things 3
tagline: The award-winning personal task manager for Mac, iPad, and iPhone
description: Things 3 is a beautifully crafted GTD task manager exclusive to the Apple ecosystem. GAIA goes further by adding proactive AI intelligence, cross-platform access, and deep integration across your entire digital workflow.
metaTitle: Things 3 Alternative with AI Email Integration — GAIA vs Things 3
metaDescription: Things 3 is beautifully designed but Apple-only and can't read your email. GAIA is an open-source Things 3 alternative with AI email integration, cross-platform support, and workflow automation across 50+ tools — free to self-host.
intro: Things 3 from Cultured Code is widely regarded as the gold standard of Apple-native task managers. Its clean design, thoughtful GTD structure with Areas and Projects, and tight OS integration have earned it a dedicated following. But Things 3 is a task manager, not an AI assistant. It requires you to do all the thinking: capturing tasks, setting deadlines, and deciding what to act on. GAIA takes a fundamentally different approach. Rather than giving you a beautiful place to store your todos, GAIA actively creates them from your emails, connects them to your calendar, and executes multi-step workflows on your behalf, on every platform you use.

verdict: Choose Things 3 if you live entirely in the Apple ecosystem, prefer a one-time purchase, and want a focused, beautifully designed GTD task manager where you control every capture and review decision. Choose GAIA if you want an AI assistant that proactively manages your tasks, email, and calendar across every platform you use — doing the work of capturing, prioritizing, and executing rather than simply storing your todos.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Things 3 for task management?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA provides AI-powered task management with projects, priorities, deadlines, labels, and natural language creation — covering everything Things 3 offers and adding proactive capabilities like creating tasks automatically from emails and calendar events. If you use Windows, Android, or the web, GAIA is also the only option, as Things 3 is Apple-exclusive.

faqs.question: Is GAIA available on Mac and iPhone like Things 3?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA runs on macOS via the desktop app, on iOS via the mobile app, and on any device through the web app. Unlike Things 3, GAIA also works on Windows, Linux, and Android, making it a practical choice for users who work across mixed-platform environments.

faqs.question: Things 3 has a one-time price. Is GAIA more expensive over time?
faqs.answer: For individual Apple users who only need task management, Things 3 can be more cost-effective over several years given its one-time pricing. GAIA's Pro plan starts at $20/month but replaces multiple tools — a task manager, email assistant, calendar tool, and automation platform — which typically cost far more individually. GAIA also offers a free tier and a self-hosting option at no cost.

whyPeopleLook: Things 3 is a masterclass in task manager design — clean, fast, and opinionated in the best way. But it is stuck in a manual, Apple-only world. There is no AI, no email integration, no cross-platform access, and no automation. Users who switch to Android, move to Windows, or simply want their task manager to do more than store GTD-style lists consistently look for alternatives that combine the simplicity of Things with the intelligence of modern AI.

alternativeFaqs.question: Does GAIA match Things 3's design quality?
alternativeFaqs.answer: Things 3 sets the bar for task manager aesthetics. GAIA's interface is clean and modern but optimized for conversational interaction and proactive intelligence rather than GTD visual organization.

alternativeFaqs.question: Can GAIA work on Android and Windows like Things 3 cannot?
alternativeFaqs.answer: Yes. GAIA has cross-platform apps including Android, web, desktop (Windows and macOS), and bot interfaces. Things 3 is limited to Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

alternativeFaqs.question: Does GAIA support GTD methodology like Things 3?
alternativeFaqs.answer: GAIA supports organizing tasks by project and priority, which can support GTD workflows. It does not enforce a specific GTD structure, instead using AI to surface the right tasks at the right time.

alternativeFaqs.question: Is GAIA free compared to Things 3's paid one-time cost?
alternativeFaqs.answer: Things 3 costs $49.99 for Mac, $9.99 for iPhone, and $19.99 for iPad — one-time. GAIA has a free tier, and self-hosting is always free. The Pro plan at $20/month is ongoing but includes AI and all integrations.
